items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: And of course Sammy Mancuso and Dolores Mancuso. ... advice of people like Sammy and Chick.

ctx.x: Who were those people for you?

Well early on Jack Palmer, a huge mentor for me. And of course Sammy Mancuso and Dolores Mancuso. Chick Esposito. You know when we were involved in that band and I would hang out with Chick a lot and do gigs with him and I learned a lot of stuff from him, and then later with Sal Amico, I mean later, like in my later teen years. Sal Amico and then of course J.R. [Monterose] and Sal Nistico and Nick Brignola. But initially I would say Jack Palmer, a huge influence. Not only about the music but about business, how…
